mapper.select: /*selectMasterMpIvQuotationSendDelayPopList*/ SELECT MAX((SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE=A.BUYER)) AS BUYER_NAME, A.QUOTATION_NO, MAX(A.BUYER_ITEM_NO) AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, MAX(A.DESCRIPTION) AS DESCRIPTION, MAX(A.MAKER_NAME) AS MAKER_NAME, MAX(A.UNIT_MEASURE) AS UNIT_MEASURE, MAX(A.BTOA_DATE) AS BTOA_DATE, MAX(A.BTOA_USER_NAME) AS BTOA_USER_NAME, MAX(NVL((SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID=A.KEP_USER_ID),'')) AS KEP_USER_NAME, MAX(TRUNC(TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'),'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')-TO_DATE(A.BTOA_END_DATE,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'))) AS DELAY_DAY, CASE WHEN MAX(A.RECV_FLAG)='GD' THEN '견적취소' ELSE CASE WHEN MAX(A.RECV_FLAG) = 'GS' THEN '결재진행중' ELSE CASE WHEN MAX(A.RECV_FLAG) = 'GR' THEN '결재반려' ELSE CASE WHEN MAX(A.RECV_FLAG)='PM' THEN '내부품의및카탈로그등록중' ELSE CASE WHEN MAX(A.RECV_FLAG)='CC' THEN '장바구니' ELSE CASE WHEN MAX(A.RECV_FLAG)='CM' THEN '합의완료' ELSE CASE WHEN MAX(A.RECV_FLAG)='PC' THEN '발주' ELSE CASE WHEN MAX(A.RECV_FLAG)='NW' THEN 'CMS매핑의뢰' ELSE CASE WHEN MAX(A.RECV_FLAG)='CR' THEN 'CMS매핑중' ELSE CASE WHEN MAX(A.RECV_FLAG)='RJ' THEN 'CMS재요청' ELSE CASE WHEN MAX(A.KEP_USER_ID) IS NULL THEN '구매사견적의뢰' ELSE CASE WHEN MAX(B.AGENT_REVISION)=1 AND MAX(A.ATOB_UNIT_PRICE)=0 AND MAX(A.ATOB_SEND_FLAG)='N' AND MAX(B.BID_SUCCESS_FLAG)<>'Y' THEN '공급사견적요청' ELSE CASE WHEN MAX(B.AGENT_REVISION)<>1 AND MAX(A.ATOB_UNIT_PRICE)=0 AND MAX(A.ATOB_SEND_FLAG)='N' THEN '공급사재견적요청' ELSE CASE WHEN MAX(A.ATOB_UNIT_PRICE)=0 AND MAX(A.ATOB_SEND_FLAG)='N' AND MAX(B.BID_SUCCESS_FLAG)='Y' THEN '공급사선정완료' ELSE CASE WHEN MAX(A.BTOA_NEGO_PRICE)=0 AND MAX(A.ATOB_UNIT_PRICE)<>0 AND MAX(A.ATOB_SEND_FLAG)='Y' THEN '구매사견적제시' ELSE CASE WHEN MAX(A.BTOA_NEGO_PRICE)<>0 AND MAX(A.ATOB_UNIT_PRICE)=0 AND MAX(A.ATOB_SEND_FLAG)='Y' THEN '구매사NEGO의뢰' ELSE CASE WHEN MAX(A.BTOA_NEGO_PRICE)<>0 AND MAX(A.ATOB_UNIT_PRICE)<>0 AND MAX(A.ATOB_SEND_FLAG)='Y' THEN '구매사NEGO견적제출' END END END END END END END END END END END END END END END END END AS SOURCING_STATUS, MAX(A.SPECIFICATION) AS SPECIFICATION, MAX((SELECT TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE='M001' AND CODE=A.ORIGIN_CODE)) AS ORIGIN_NAME, MAX(A.ITEM_QTY) AS ITEM_QTY, MAX(A.BTOA_END_DATE) AS BTOA_END_DATE, MAX(A.BTOA_USER_TEL) AS BTOA_USER_TEL, MAX(B.ATOS_END_DATE) AS ATOS_END_DATE, MAX(A.BUYER) AS BUYER, MAX(A.QUOTATION_SEQ) AS QUOTATION_SEQ, MAX(A.REVISION) AS REVISION, DECODE(MAX(A.DELAY_REASON_CODE),'','0','1') AS DELAY_REASON_IMG, MAX(A.DELAY_REASON_CODE) AS DELAY_REASON_CODE, MAX(A.DELAY_RESION_NOTE) AS DELAY_RESION_NOTE, MAX(A.DELAY_SEND_MAIL_FLAG) AS DELAY_SEND_MAIL_FLAG FROM KEPRQDT A , KEPQTDT B , KEP_PM_PA_LIST C WHERE A.BUYER=#{st_buyer} AND A.BTOA_DATE>='20090101' AND A.BUYER=C.BUYER AND A.QUOTATION_NO=C.KEY1 AND A.QUOTATION_SEQ=C.KEY2 AND A.REVISION=C.KEY3 AND A.ITEM_GROUP=C.KEY4 AND A.ITEM_GROUP=#{st_item_group} AND C.GUBUN='QT_DELAY' AND A.STATUS ^='D' AND A.RECV_FLAG='GA' AND A.SO_CA_FLAG='SO' AND A.ATOB_SEND_FLAG='N' AND TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.BTOA_END_DATE,'YYYYMMDD')+1,'YYYYMMDD')<=TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.BTOA_END_DATE,'YYYYMMDD')+7,'YYYYMMDD')>TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') AND A.BUYER=B.BUYER(+) AND A.QUOTATION_NO=B.QUOTATION_NO(+) AND A.QUOTATION_SEQ=B.QUOTATION_SEQ(+) AND A.REVISION=B.REVISION(+) AND B.STATUS(+)='C' GROUP BY A.BUYER, A.QUOTATION_NO, A.QUOTATION_SEQ, A.REVISION
